_status: M1 seed complete 3 Aug 2026 — see docs/proposal/m1-streams-seed.json for the full 34-stream extraction this is derived from. Driver is 3 values, counted from the real 34 streams: OM Governance (24 + the 2 previously mis-split as 'OM Compliance' = 26), OM Market Expansion (5), OM Efficiency (3). Examples below are the real stream names (evidence, not invented); descriptions are short factual summaries of what those real streams have in common, not designed categories.

drivers.name: OM Governance
drivers.description: The largest group by far (26/34). Internal structural governance moves: entity setup/relocation, licence reuse, HR/market structure, GDPR and other compliance reviews. Includes the 2 streams previously mis-tagged as a separate 'OM Compliance' driver (Diane's correction, 3 Aug 2026): Cruise Applications Decomissioning, CAA Audit - ATOL Adequacy Actions.
examples: PT Licence Reuse for EU Markets

drivers.name: OM Market Expansion
drivers.description: 5/34. Opening or configuring the group's presence in a new market/entity setup for it (Greece VAT representation, LMNext US B2B/telesales, market prioritisation for Brazil/Saudi Arabia/UAE).

drivers.name: OM Efficiency
drivers.description: 3/34, the smallest group. Reviewing/streamlining an existing setup rather than governing or expanding it (telesales focal point, PT invoicing switch, hotel FR entity switch).

functions._note: Closed list confirmed 3 Aug 2026, derived from row-label frequency across the real 34 streams (docs/proposal/m1-streams-seed.json). Fixed defaults are always assessed; optional ones are added deliberately based on need, per Diane's decision — this is not an open/free-text list.
